def is_prime(n):
    if n < 2:
        return False
    d = 2
    while d * d <= n:
        if n % d == 0:
            return False
        d += 1
    return True

def prime_factors(n):
    fs = set()
    d = 2
    while d * d <= n:
        while n % d == 0:
            fs.add(d)
            n //= d
        d += 1
    if n > 1:
        fs.add(n)
    return sorted(fs)

    return a
